arxiv-1511-03406.title: Implementing a Small Parsing Virtual Machine on Embedded Systems
arxiv-1511-03406.creator: Shun Honda, Kimio Kuramitsu
arxiv-1511-03406.description: Abstract PEGs are a formal grammar foundation for describing syntax, and are not hard to generate parsers with a plain recursive decent parsing. However, the large amount of C-stack consumption in the recursive parsing is not acceptable especially in resource-restricted embedded systems. Alternatively, we have attempted the machine virtualization approach to PEG-based parsing.

arxiv-2007-14858.title: Evidence for t ​ t ¯ ​ t ​ t ¯ t\bar{t}t\bar{t} production in the multilepton final state in proton–proton collisions at s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-2007-14858.creator: The ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-2007-14858.description: Abstract A search is presented for four-top-quark production using an integrated luminosity of 139 fb -1 of proton–proton collision data at a centre-of-mass energy of 13 ​ TeV 13\penalty\ \text{Te\kern-1.00006ptV} collected by the ATLAS detector at the LHC. Events are selected if they contain a same-sign lepton pair or at least three leptons (electrons or muons).

arxiv-2102-05834.title: On minimal surfaces immersed in three dimensional Kropina Minkowski space
arxiv-2102-05834.creator: Ranadip Gangopadhyay, Ashok Kumar, Bankteshwar Tiwari
arxiv-2102-05834.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Ranadip Gangopadhyay, Ashok Kumar, Bankteshwar Tiwari. In this paper we consider a three dimensional Kropina space and obtain the partial differential equation that characterizes a minimal surfaces with the induced metric. Using this characterization equation we study various immersions of minimal surfaces. In particular, we obtain the partial differential equation that characterizes the minimal translation surfaces and show that the plane is the only such surface.

arxiv-2203-12461.title: Intralayer and interlayer synchronization in multiplex network with higher-order interactions
arxiv-2203-12461.creator: Md Sayeed Anwar, Dibakar Ghosh
arxiv-2203-12461.description: Abstract Recent developments in complex systems have witnessed that many real-world scenarios, successfully represented as networks are not always restricted to binary interactions but often include higher-order interactions among the nodes. These beyond pairwise interactions are preferably modeled by hypergraphs, where hyperedges represent higher-order interactions between a set of nodes.

arxiv-2312-14903.title: Scalable Agent-Based Modeling for Complex Financial Market Simulations
arxiv-2312-14903.creator: Aaron Wheeler, Jeffrey D. Varner
arxiv-2312-14903.description: Abstract In this study, we developed a computational framework for simulating large-scale agent-based financial markets. Our platform supports trading multiple simultaneous assets and leverages distributed computing to scale the number and complexity of simulated agents. Heterogeneous agents make decisions in parallel, and their orders are processed through a realistic, continuous double auction matching engine.

Meyer, Emanuele Paolo Farina, Eduardo Bañados, Fabian Walter, Roberto Decarli, Silvia Belladitta, Federica Loiacono. arxiv-2404-13214.title: Time-dependent Stellar Flare Models of Deep Atmospheric Heating
arxiv-2404-13214.creator: Adam F. Kowalski, Joel C. Allred, Mats Carlsson
arxiv-2404-13214.description: Abstract Optical flares have been observed from magnetically active stars for many decades; unsurprisingly, the spectra and temporal evolution are complicated. For example, the shortcomings of optically thin, static slab models have long been recognized when confronted with the observations.

arxiv-2410-12377.title: HerO at AVeriTeC: The Herd of Open Large Language Models for Verifying Real-World Claims
arxiv-2410-12377.creator: Yejun Yoon Jaeyoon Jung Seunghyun Yoon Kunwoo Park
arxiv-2410-12377.description: Abstract To tackle the AVeriTeC shared task hosted by the FEVER-24, we introduce a system that only employs publicly available large language models (LLMs) for each step of automated fact-checking, dubbed the Her d of O pen LLMs for verifying real-world claims ( HerO ).

arxiv-2508-16915.title: Reinforcement-Guided Hyper-Heuristic Hyperparameter Optimization for Fair and Explainable Spiking Neural Network-Based Financial Fraud Detection
arxiv-2508-16915.creator: Sadman Mohammad Nasif, Md Abrar Jahin, M. F. Mridha
arxiv-2508-16915.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sadman Mohammad Nasif, Md Abrar Jahin, M. F. Mridha. The growing adoption of home banking systems has heightened the risk of cyberfraud, necessitating fraud detection mechanisms that are not only accurate but also fair and explainable. While AI models have shown promise in this domain, they face key limitations, including computational inefficiency, the interpretability challenges of spiking neural networks (SNNs), and the complexity and convergence instability of hyper-heuristic reinforcement learning (RL)-based hyperparameter optimization.

pmc-11404664.title: Community-Specific Video Training for Primary Care Settings: Increasing Capacity and Motivation to Address Food Insecurity
pmc-11404664.creator: Andrea Nederveld, Kathryn Jantz, Margery Brennan, Macharnie Skalecki, Elena Broaddus-Shea
pmc-11404664.description: BackgroundFood insecurity (FI) is the most common health-related social need (HRSN) and is frequently identified in primary care through screening and referral. However, health care workers often do not have the knowledge, motivation, capability, or opportunity necessary to discuss FI with patients in patient-centered ways.

pmc-11690797.title: FRIENDS WITH UNEXPECTED BENEFITS: COACHING CAREGIVERS OF PEOPLE LIVING WITH DEMENTIA
pmc-11690797.creator: Rita Jablonski, Amy Cleverdon, Chunhong Xiao, Reed Bratches
pmc-11690797.description: Persons living with dementia (PLWD) often exhibit care-resistant behaviors (CRBs), including refusing to take medications or bathe. This randomized clinical trial is currently enrolling caregivers of people living with dementia, who receive nine one-hour coaching sessions designed to help them prevent and manage CRBs.

pmc-12455728.title: Ease pediatric emergency department crowding in Switzerland with high-quality telephone triage: a prospective multicenter study
pmc-12455728.creator: Krisztina Schmitz-Grosz, Carsten Sommer-Meyer, Stéphanie van der Lely, Siro Fritzmann, Georg Staubli, Eva Berger-Olah
pmc-12455728.description: IntroductionThis is the first study evaluating the picture of a pediatric telephone triage service's (PTTS) quality from the hospital, telemedical, and patient perspective, to provide a deeper understanding of its contribution to the relief of pediatric emergency burden.MethodsWe conducted a prospective multicenter study from April 3 to May 15, 2023.

pmc-13406185.title: A bibliometric analysis of the pathophysiology of sepsis-associated acute kidney injury from 2015 to 2024
pmc-13406185.creator: Saiping Qi, Jianxin Zhou, Hongliang Li
pmc-13406185.description: Background:The pathophysiology of sepsis-associated acute kidney injury (SA-AKI) urgently needs to be further explored to translate these findings into potential early diagnostic methods and effective therapeutic strategies. This study aims to analyze the current landscape and development trend related to the pathophysiology of SA-AKI.
